title: Attack State Machine — foothold model + TAP-style attack tree per hypothesis
goal: Layer 3 of the new architectuur: foothold_state per run ∈ {anonymous, authenticated_user, admin, file_read, code_execution, shell_like}. Attack tree per finding. TAP-style breadth-first + depth-first + pruning. Recursion + back-to-root per exhausted branch. Replay-first on previously-proven paths (uses backlog-410 episodic memory).
scope: (1) New `api/app/services/attack_state.py`: FootholdState dataclass + AttackTree (LangGraph-style stateful graph). (2) State transitions triggered by validator-verified exploits (backlog-413 will provide verifier). (3) `attack_tree_step(run, current_foothold) -> next_hypothesis | back_off | exhausted`. (4) Picker prompt receives current_foothold + tree_state. (5) Replay-first: at run-start, check episodic memory for proven paths on similar targets; try those first.
generation_reason: Per user's vision: 'find 1 high, exploit to layer 3, back to layer 1 for next exploit'. Per Cyber-AutoAgent KNOW→THINK→TEST→VALIDATE pattern. Currently AegisPT has no foothold concept — every advance is stateless. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: metric is 'foothold transitions observed' + 'attack-tree depth reached'.

constraints.active_task_gate: Single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: State machine + tree only. No validator logic (413). No multi-agent (415).
constraints.no_unverified_transitions: Foothold transitions ONLY on validator-verified exploits. No claim-based transitions.

success_criteria: Metric: ≥1 run shows foothold transition from anonymous → authenticated_user via verified exploit (on XBOW or harness target).
Metric: attack_tree depth ≥3 hops on ≥1 run.
Metric: replay-first proven path retry test passes (synthetic episodic memory + recall + replay).
Foothold state visible in run.attack_state JSON; transition history in DB.
TAP-style pruning: dead branches marked exhausted, picker doesn't re-pick them.
Live (after-412 XBOW): score +5-10% vs after-411 (foothold-aware picker reaches more challenges).

acceptance_criteria: Foothold transition observed in live run.

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with foothold transition evidence + tree depth metric + XBOW delta + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
